text:
Ivy: Heads up - were prepping a follow-up social burst after the "Serving at Scale" webinar. Need quick turnaround social posts (X + LinkedIn) with recording, TL;DR thread, and gated slide deck for top leads. Who can sprint?

Marco: I can take X TL;DR thread + pin recording tweet. Plan: 5-tweet TL;DR (key stat, 3 takeaways, link to recording + deck gate).

Rina: Ill do LinkedIn long-form recap + carousel (4 cards). Also will draft a short "watch the clip" for sponsored posts.

Dylan: Ill set up the gated deck in HubSpot and the form. Use existing `webinar_serving_at_scale_2026` with extra field 'interest_area'.

Tess: Can design export a vertical clip for Stories and a 9:16 for ad placements? Also need a thumbnail for YouTube.

Ivy: Post cadence: immediate recording tweet + LinkedIn recap 1hr after; follow-up retarget ads 24h later. SDRs to receive top-50 list within 2h of event close.

Marco: For the thread wording Im thinking:
- Tweet 1: Recording up -> TL;DR in thread + reg CTA
- Tweet 2: Stat card (internal benchmark 2.3x cost reduction) + methodology link
- Tweet 3: Most asked Q + short answer
- Tweet 4: How to get the slide deck (gate link)
- Tweet 5: CTA to book 1:1 (top 50)

Rina: Legal note - ensure "internal benchmark" phrasing on stat card and link to blog methods.

Dylan: Routing: mark attendees with 'attended=true' and push to SDRs if job_title matches eng tags. Deck gate flow: require job_title, company, and intended use.

Tess: Will drop assets in #design-handoff in 2hrs.

Ivy: Also want post-live engagement plan: 2 people for replies, 1 person for DMs, 1 on comments on LI. Keep a short FAQ doc.

Marco: Will draft the thread now and post after approval.

ShortLink Bot: Generated short links: primary rwd.in/serve-webinar, backup rwd.in/serve.

Ivy: Great. Deadline: all live within 90 mins of webinar end. React with :+1: if you can.
